privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Norless keeps songs, playlists and what is live for churches. To let people log in and work together, it keeps a little about them. This page says what, why, for how long, and who to ask.
privacy.responsible: Each community is responsible for the personal data of its people, and decides what it is used for. Write to it with any question:
privacy.operator: This server is run by {{operator}}, who processes the data on the communities' behalf.
privacy.transfers: Google LLC is in the United States: if you choose Continue with Google, what your browser and Norless send it goes there, under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Notifications reach your device through your browser's push service (Google, Apple or Mozilla), encrypted so that it can't read them.

kept.account: Your account: your name and email address, until you or an owner delete it.
kept.google: If you log in with Google: only the name, email address and profile photo Google gives Norless, nothing from your Google account beyond that. Norless keeps a small copy of the photo as your avatar, which members of your community see, and the photo's address, to copy it again every week; on My account you can upload another or use your initials. Norless contacts Google only once you choose Continue with Google: then Google's sign-in loads from accounts.google.com, or you go to Google's own page. No other page of Norless loads anything from Google.
kept.history: Who did what: each change to songs, playlists, settings, members and recordings, with who made it, when, and what it was before, which the owners can read; and when songs were played. If you delete your account, your changes stay without your name.
kept.sessions: Your login: a random token in a cookie, for 30 days, renewed while you use Norless; logging out ends it.
kept.links: Login links sent by email: they work once, for 15 minutes (invitations two days), and are deleted a day after they expire, or with your account.
kept.preferences: Your preferences: layouts, colors and text size for each kind of device.
kept.usage: How Norless is used: what was used, when, and on which kind of device and layout, with your account unless you switch that off on My account. Kept in Norless for good, without your account once you delete it; only its app team sees it.
kept.online: While you're connected, that you're online and on what kind of device; this isn't stored.
kept.logs: Server logs: IP addresses and the pages asked for, to find problems. The oldest go once they fill 30 MB, and all of them with each new version of Norless: a few days' or weeks' worth.
kept.backups: Backups: copies of all of this, kept 14 days on the server. The operator also keeps a copy a day, and the recordings, on their own computer for good, to restore Norless if the server is lost.
kept.recordings: Recordings: what the team recorded in rehearsals and services, with who recorded it and who may listen; the stage screens show while recording is on. Kept until whoever recorded it or an owner deletes it; if whoever recorded it deletes their account, it stays for the team, without their name, and the whole team may listen to it.

privacy.why: All of this is to let you log in, to let the team work together and see who did what, and to remember how you like Norless. The community does it on the basis of its legitimate interest in organizing its services and its team, and in seeing how Norless is used; login emails and notifications are sent because you asked for them.
privacy.visitors: If you use Norless without an account, it keeps only the server logs and how it's used, with nothing that says who you are; your choices stay in your own browser.
privacy.children: People under 16 join with the agreement of a parent or guardian.
privacy.cookies: Norless sets only the cookies it needs to log you in: __Host-session, with your login, for 30 days, renewed while you use Norless; and, only once you choose Continue with Google, __Host-google-nonce and __Host-google, for the 10 minutes that login may take. No ads, no tracking, no analytics, and its fonts and pictures come from Norless itself, so there is no cookie banner.
privacy.rights: You may ask to see your data and get a copy, to have it corrected or deleted, to limit how it is used, to object to its use, and to get it in a form you can take elsewhere. Write to your community, at its contact above.
privacy.complaint: If you think your data isn't handled as it should be, you may also complain to Romania's data protection authority, ANSPDCP (dataprotection.ro).
privacy.delete: To delete your account, choose "Delete my account…" on My account: your name, email, photo and login links are removed and you are logged out everywhere. What you added stays, without your name, and so do the recordings you made, for the team. Backups with your data are gone from the server within 14 days; the operator's own copies are kept.

webhooks.name: Webhooks
webhooks.adds: Other apps follow the service: when an entry goes live, when it starts and ends.

offline.name: Offline
offline.adds: Songs and the newest playlists kept on a device, so it projects without internet, with playlists made there by searching them.

serviceRoles.name: Service roles
serviceRoles.adds: Who plays, sings and serves in each service, from a template per weekly event: each member's own schedule, sign-ups for open places, away dates, and who leads each song.

pushNotifications.name: Notifications
pushNotifications.adds: Notifications on phones: when you're scheduled, reminders and open places.

churchCalendar.name: Church calendar
churchCalendar.adds: What's coming in the church's calendar, on My schedule and the team schedule, read from its iCal address.

playlistNews.name: Playlist news
playlistNews.adds: The team tells a service's people its playlist is ready, and its musicians hear of songs changed after.

replays.name: Watch again
replays.adds: Each song's moments in the services' YouTube streams: on its page, in a past playlist's entries and in the statistics.

bigScreen.name: Big screen
bigScreen.adds: A laptop layout for Full HD, QHD and 4K windows: every screen and every musician's device at once, and the room's information.

welcome.name: Welcome page
welcome.adds: A built-in page for the projectors before a service: the community's name and logo, a countdown and announcements.

insertBetween.name: Add between rows
insertBetween.adds: A + between a playlist's rows adds a song, a divider or a text slide right there.

detect.title: Play a chord
detect.inputHelp: A microphone hears the whole room; the mixer's input hears one instrument clearly.
detect.noMidi: This browser can't use a MIDI piano: Chrome or Edge on Android or a laptop can. Listening works everywhere.
detect.denied: Norless may not use it: allow it in the browser's site settings.
detect.plugIn: Plug in a MIDI piano, or connect a Bluetooth one.
detect.how: Tap a letter, then play the chord: it goes there when you let go of the keys. While listening, the chord heard is offered when you tap a letter.
detect.nobody: Nobody is sharing chords right now. A team member shares them from this view's Share chords menu: from a piano, the mixer or a microphone.

team.title: Team schedule
team.help: Who does what in the coming services and rehearsals. The team fills the places; each person accepts or declines their own.
team.membersOnly: The team schedule is for the community's members.
team.noEventsHelp: The schedule follows the services and rehearsals in Settings → Schedule.
team.noSlots: No places set for this date yet.
team.noSlotsTeam: No places yet: add some, or set what this service starts with below.
team.templatesHelp: For each weekly service or rehearsal, the places each of its dates starts with; change a date on its own above.
team.peopleHelp: People marked for a role take its open places at once and hear when one opens. Those who play an instrument are marked for its role already.
team.byInstrument: Those who play its instrument in their musician profile count too.
team.noneYours: Nothing for you in the coming weeks.
team.openForYou: Open places for you this week
team.awayHelp: The team sees them when it plans.
team.pushInstallHow: On an iPhone: open Norless in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen; open it from there and turn notifications on. Until then, what's new shows here and at the top of the pages.
team.pushOff: This server doesn't send notifications yet: what's new shows here and at the top of the pages.
team.pushOn: Notifications are on for this device.
team.pushDenied: The browser blocks them: allow notifications for Norless in its settings.
team.pushKeys: Only here: notifications to phones aren't set up yet
team.pushDevices: Only here: none of your devices allowed notifications
team.rolesHelp: The roles of a service, for the team schedule. A role for an instrument marks those who play it.
team.noDates: No services in the coming weeks
team.noDatesHelp: The schedule shows the services and rehearsals of the next 8 weeks, from Settings → Schedule.
team.ledByHelp: From this service's slots. Without a choice, the worship lead leads.
team.ledByNobody: Nobody leads or sings in this service's slots yet: the team schedule fills them.

calendar.title: In the church's calendar
calendar.failed: The calendar couldn't be read just now; these are from before.
calendar.settingsHelp: Members see what's coming in the church's calendar on My schedule and the team schedule. Paste its iCal address: in Google Calendar, the calendar's settings, "Secret address in iCal format". Only owners see the address.
calendar.addressHelp: https://… or webcal://…, read again every hour.
calendar.notRead: Couldn't read a calendar at this address.

offline.keepHelp: This device keeps every song and the newest playlists, to project without internet.
offline.offWithout: There's no internet: switched off, this device forgets the kept songs and can't keep them again until the internet is back. Switch off anyway?
offline.title: Offline
offline.keptOn: Kept on this device on {{at}}: {{count}} songs and {{playlists}} playlists.
offline.nothingHelp: With internet, switch on "Keep songs for offline" in This device, under the live controls; then this page projects them without internet.

news.tellHelp: Everyone in this service's slots is told the playlist is ready, in Norless and on phones with notifications. Songs changed after this are told to its musicians and singers.
news.nobody: Nobody is in this service's slots yet: the team schedule fills them.

replays.title: Watch again
replays.latest: {{title}}: its latest service in the stream

slides.asPdf: A presentation is added as a PDF: export it first. PowerPoint: File → Save As → PDF. Keynote: File → Export To → PDF. Google Slides and Canva: Download → PDF.
slides.timerHelp: From 3 to 120. It starts from this entry, loops after the last page, and stops when anything else goes live.
slides.title: Title

bigScreen.nobody: No Vocals or Instruments view is open now.

welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.settingsHelp: Shown on the projectors from the Pages menu before a service: the community's name and logo, a countdown to the next service or rehearsal, and these announcements, one after another.
welcome.announcementsHelp: A blank line between two announcements. Markdown works: **bold**, # a heading.
